mapper.select: SELECT a.id, article_cover, article_title, a.create_time, a.type, a.is_top, a.category_id, category_name, t.id AS tag_id, t.tag_name FROM ( SELECT id, article_cover, article_title, type, is_top, create_time, category_id FROM tb_article WHERE is_delete = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY is_top DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{current} , #{size} ) a LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tb_article_tag atg ON a.id = atg.article_id LEFT JOIN tb_tag t ON t.id = atg.tag_id ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.id DESC

category_id = #{condition.categoryId}

SELECT a.id, article_cover, article_title, a.type, a.original_url, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.category_id, ca.version AS content_version, category_name, t.id AS tag_id, t.tag_name FROM tb_article a LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tb_article_tag atg ON a.id = atg.article_id LEFT JOIN tb_tag t ON t.id = atg.tag_id LEFT JOIN tb_content_asset ca ON ca.asset_id = a.content_asset_id AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE a.id = #{articleId} AND a.is_delete = 0 AND a.status = 1
